text: True or False: Because of the skin effect, a copper trace's loss rises with frequency (R proportional to sqrt(f)), whereas optical fiber loss is essentially independent of the modulation frequency.
explanation: True. The skin effect makes conductor resistance grow as sqrt(f), so copper reaches ~40 dB/m by 100 GHz and needs equalization or repeaters, while fiber attenuation is flat across the whole modulation band. This frequency-independence is a key optical advantage.
